subject.title: WhatsApp: add configurable send retry for transient network errors

question: Should WhatsApp get a new configurable send-retry surface, and if so should retry be default-on for existing users or opt-in behind explicit config?
rationale: Current main already has queue/reconnect recovery and an explicit no-retry safety test for direct sends, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent delivery semantics or duplicate-send risk tolerance.

options.title: Require opt-in or queue-aware retry
options.body: Port the implementation to current main but keep retry disabled unless config or durable delivery state proves a retry is safe.

options.title: Sponsor default-on retry
options.body: Maintain the PR's default-on behavior only after owner approval and live proof that accepted-but-thrown sends do not duplicate in the supported transient cases.

options.title: Close as covered by queue work
options.body: If maintainers decide the existing delivery queue and reconnect drain are sufficient, close this PR and leave configurable send retry out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Require opt-in or queue-aware retry
recommendation.body: Port the implementation to current main but keep retry disabled unless config or durable delivery state proves a retry is safe.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc already made the cluster-level distinction between current main's shipped queue/reconnect work and this adjacent configurable retry surface.
